# Mine Koçak — UGC creator (Bangkok)

> Mine Koçak is a Turkish UGC creator based in Bangkok, Thailand. She makes short vertical videos for beauty, nails, fashion, wellness, café and restaurant brands, in English or Turkish.

- Site: https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mineexplora/
- Email: mineexplora@gmail.com
- Brand collabs: Wilder (electrolyte drink mix), ICA Makeup Academy Bangkok.
- Venue feature: Kiwamiya at Siam Paragon (restaurant), posted with @moviatravelhub.
- Product features: Impress press-on nails, GRWM makeup and outfit videos.

## Rates (USD)
- Single video up to 30 s: $180
- Trio, 3 videos + 3 extra hooks: $480
- Monthly, 6 videos + 6 hooks + 10 photos: $900
- Bangkok venue visit reel: $220
- Paid ads usage: +30% (30 days), +50% (90 days), +100% (12 months)
- Whitelisting / Partnership Ads: $100 per video per 30 days
- Included: captions, one revision, 12 months organic usage on the brand's channels.

## Process
Brief → concept and script in 48 hours → filmed and edited within 5 working days of product arrival → delivery with one revision.
